scripts.text:
{0}
Hello~
Welcome to ^8B4513Ayothaya^000000.
This town is linked to a river through the wild forest.
It's a really calm country.
Take your time to look around.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你好~
歡迎來到^8B4513哎喲泰雅^000000。
這座城鎮通過茂密的森林與河流相連。
這裡是一個非常寧靜的國度。
請慢慢四處看看吧。

{0}
哎喲泰雅的{1}裡有特殊的武器。
你可以在那裡找到很棒的武器。
還有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
Our citizens purchase many products in the {1}.
Make sure you get all you need there.
Do you need anything else?
scripts.translation:
{0}
我們的市民會在{1}購買許多商品。
請確保在那裡買到你需要的所有東西。
你還需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
Part of adventuring is collecting information.
The {1} is crowded with lots of travelers where you can get useful information.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
{0}
冒險的一部分就是收集情報。
{1}裡擠滿了許多旅行者，你可以從他們那裡獲得有用的資訊。
還有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
Ayothaya is close to the beach, so most people enjoy fishing.
They really love to fish.
Go {1} and try to grab a big fish.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
{0}
哎喲泰雅靠近海灘，所以大多數人喜歡釣魚。
他們真的很愛釣魚。
去{1}試著釣一條大魚吧。
還有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？
